decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Digital Transformation Project, under the Digital Economy Strategy (2025 - 2030), has been prepared with a view to modernizing the delivery of public services efficiently and transparently through digital methods, which is a national policy priority. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to obtain the assistance of international development partners for the implementation of the said project. The loan negotiations initiated accordingly with the participation of all stakeholders of the Government of Sri Lanka and the World Bank Group for obtaining funds for the said project, have been concluded by now. According to the agreements reached at the said discussions, the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development will function as the borrower of the loan facility on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, and GovTech Sri Lanka will act as the implementing agency for the implementation of the said project. The Ministry of Digital Economy has been entrusted with the policy oversight and inter-ministerial coordination in relation to the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to secure Special Drawing Rights (SDR) funds equivalent to US$ 50 million from the World Bank Group for the proposed project, based on the financial terms and conditions recommended by the Public Debt Management Office under the provisions of the Public Debt Management Act, No.33 of 2024, was approved by the Cabinet.
